game_title: Off By One Autopsy – Sandstorm Pass Rush
game_concept: A speed quiz set in Sand Dunes – Sandstorm Pass, a pass in a sandstorm: the caravan guide must handle scarab swarms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Off By One Autopsy: Diagnose off-by-one failures in loops and indexes in a broken script.
theme: Sand Dunes – Sandstorm Pass: a pass in a sandstorm
core_gameplay_loop: In Sandstorm Pass, repeat each round: Diagnose off-by-one failures in loops and indexes in a broken script. Each round, a new water flasks challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the autopsy value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 390 points of water flasks by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 390, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 6 (applied tier): Off By One Autopsy
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Off By One Autopsy' (Week 9 slot 6), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Sandstorm Pass'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how autopsy changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against scarab swarms in Sandstorm Pass.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 390 within 36 seconds.
